newsitem.title: USA: New Jersey mayor commits suicide in office.
newsitem.headline: New Jersey mayor commits suicide in office.

text.p: The mayor of suburban Mahwah Township fatally shot himself in the head while sitting at his desk, police said on Tuesday.
Mayor David Dwork's body was discovered shortly before 11 p.m. EDT on Monday at the Mahwah Township municipal offices, police said.
The body had a single gunshot wound to the head, and a handgun was found at the scene, police said. The county medical examiner determined the wound was self-inflicted.
The circumstances of his death were under investigation, police said. The body was discovered by a janitor.
"There is nothing to indicate why this might have happened," said Bob Anderson, the township's business administrator.
"He really enjoyed what he was doing," Anderson said. "Everything he did was how could he help the township."
There was no public indication that Dwork was in poor health or any sort of trouble, he said. "We have no idea. It's just traumatic."
Dwork, 58, was a former Township council president, became acting mayor in 1991, was elected to his first full term as mayor in 1992 and was reelected in 1996.
He was married 37 years to his wife Johanna. They had a son, a daughter and two grandchildren.
Mahwah Township, with a population of 23,000, is about 30 miles northwest of New York City, near New Jersey's border with New York state.
